expectations.text: Should invoke A.1 spec-drafter to create proposal.md

expectations.text: Should invoke A.3 agent allocation as final step
expectations.evidence: 执行计划最后一行: "A.3     task-planner → Agent 分配"; 执行结果最后一行: "✅ A.3   完成 → Agent 已分配 (4 类)"; 正文 "## 5. expectations.text: Steps must execute in A.1 → A.2 → A.3 order
expectations.evidence: 「🚀 执行中...」区块逐行顺序为 "⚠️ A.1-pre 未能执行" → "✅ A.1   完成 → Spec: add-oauth2-social-login (Level 3, draft)" → "⚠️ A.post 跑了 3 轮 → PASS_WITH_WARNINGS" → "✅ A.2   完成 → 任务数: 20 (72-104h)" → "✅ A.3   完成 → Agent 已分配 (4 类)"; 正文小节亦按 "## 2.
